how_to_run: From this folder: python3 ../../framework-evals/run_eval.py <out-dir> <eval-id>... --evals evals.json (runs: 3 each; the run student scripts are in framework-evals/students/; dir: fixtures are relative to this folder).

evals.name: reads-inputs
evals.prompt: Run the run skill for Sales Pre-Call Brief.
evals.expected_output: Run reads ## Inputs (not Step 1) to say what to have ready, and lists the input marked not available yet.

expectations.text: Run says what the student needs in hand from `## Inputs`: the calendar invite for the booked call (I1), not a Step 1 Inputs field
Run lists I2 (the booking form's "What would you like to cover?" answer) as not available yet
When Run refers to the plan it calls it the Design Plan and reads `design-plan.md`
No Run Card is written before the first real run
